The formatting tool successfully normalized the URL to lowercase, returning https://www.veridiandynamics.com. This confirms the link is consistent and ready for QR code generation. I will now proceed to generate the QR code using this normalized URL.

The QR code generation succeeded, returning the image URL https://cdn.flowcode.com/assets/qr_5t8v2w9x4y7z1a3b.png. This provides the specific link required to fulfill the user's SMS request. I will now proceed to send this image link to the requested phone numbers.
